name: Step Detector
description: Heel-strike step detection from ankle accelerometry using Savitzky-Golay smoothing, adaptive threshold, and peak detection (Romera-Manchado et al., 2025).

parameters.name: min_step_interval_ms
parameters.label: Minimum Step Interval (ms)
parameters.description: Minimum time between steps — limits max cadence to ~200 steps/min

parameters.name: threshold_multiplier
parameters.label: Adaptive Threshold Multiplier
parameters.description: Peak height threshold as multiple of the rolling 2s standard deviation
